inputs.userGoal: lets focus only on platform engineering.
subGoals: No OT connectivity or workload deployment

plan.validation: Azure subscription deployment Succeeded in eastus2. All three private endpoints Succeeded and Approved. Local compilation and eight guard tests pass; Checkov 18 passed, zero failed, one documented quarantine exception. Data-plane acceptance remains pending a private client.

overallReasoning.summary: Platform-only Bicep foundation in verified company subscription; artifacts produced under referenced-workload answer-first workflow.
overallReasoning.tradeoffs: No compute, workloads, enterprise policy, budget or recovery deployment. Quarantine deferred until image release pipeline. No live resources existed in inventory.
